messages:
Alex (Sales): Hey @Morgan @Devon — Prospect (large fintech) just asked for IAM/SAML + MFA enforcement + RBAC evidence for their SIG/CAIQ review. They want an artifact bundle and a short POC next week. Can we assemble what they usually ask for and call out any Dedicated/Private differences? ETA?

Morgan (Security): OK — I can pull the core artifacts. Will include: SAML metadata (IdP/SP), SCIM provisioning guide, MFA enforcement policy excerpt, RBAC role matrix CSV, sample service-account least-privilege policies, audit-log retention statement, and a sanitized audit snippet. Also a short writeup on how we enforce role separation and review cadence.

Alex (Sales): Awesome — can you confirm whether hosted (Redwood API) supports enforcing org-wide MFA via SAML assertions, or is that only on Dedicated/Private? Prospect will push for hard enforcement in their contract.

Devon (Presales): Quick answer: MFA enforcement is primarily handled by the customer's IdP via SAML assertions for hosted. We consume the SAML Authn and honor the assertion (e.g., ACR level). For Dedicated/Private we can surface an org-level flag that rejects non-MFA sessions at the edge if you want strict enforcement on our side — it's doable but is an addendum. I'll note pricing impact.

Morgan (Security): To add detail: hosted flow = rely on IdP (SAML) with enforced MFA at IdP; we validate the assertion and map to RBAC. For Dedicated/Private we can enable token gating (configurable) to reject tokens if MFA claim missing. Implementation note: requires a config change + test for token lifetimes.

Alex (Sales): Prospect also asked for sample RBAC roles + principle of least privilege examples for their legal/compliance team. Can we give a template they can use?

Sam (Solutions): I'll produce a trimmed RBAC JSON + CSV role matrix for them. Will include examples: "read-only-embed", "model-admin" (limited to model ops), "billing-viewer". Will also include a SCIM patch example for provisioning and a sample SCIM payload for group sync.

Morgan (Security): Checklist I'm going to assemble (ETA 2 business days):
- SAML SP metadata XML (entityID, ACS URL)
- SCIM provisioning API doc + sample payloads
- MFA enforcement policy excerpt + verification notes (how we map ACR claim)
- RBAC role matrix (CSV) + sample JSON policies
- Service account best-practices doc + rotation cadence
- Audit log retention statement + one sanitized log snippet (timestamps redacted)
- Notes on least-privilege and periodic access review cadence

Alex (Sales): Perfect. Can you also state whether we support automated provisioning via SCIM group-to-role mapping? Prospect wants proof they can automate deprovisioning.

Sam (Solutions): Yes — we support SCIM group sync. Typical mapping: SCIM group name -> Redwood role. I'll include example mapping and a quick Postman collection to demo.

Devon (Presales): On the POC timeline: recommend 3 items for next week — 1) 30-min security walkthrough (Morgan + Sam) 2) SCIM test with their IdP (30–60m) 3) brief RBAC demo (15m). If artifacts are ready in 48hrs we can schedule the walkthrough on Day 3.

Morgan (Security): Note on redaction/privacy: audit snippets will be sanitized (no user PII). If they require raw logs we need a legal NDA and S3 access approach — mention in the reply.

Alex (Sales): Pricing flag: Prospect asked if Dedicated adds extra security controls out-of-the-box vs hosted and if that changes baseline commitment. Devon, can you add a short note about cost delta and contract lead time when you add the enforcement addendum?

Devon (Presales): Will add: Dedicated = reserved capacity + optional token-gating feature (+security addendum). Expect procurement lead time ~4–6 weeks for enterprise legal + 2–4 weeks for Dedicated capacity provisioning depending on region. Price delta: I'll give ballpark in the reply doc (range, not final).

Morgan (Security): One more technical detail to include in the reply: certificate rotation for SAML (IdP cert rollover). Provide recommended SP cert rotation cadence and a sample rotation plan (backup cert, test window).

Alex (Sales): Great, thanks everyone. Can we aim to have the artifact bundle and draft reply to the SIG/CAIQ question by EOD tomorrow? I'll send the questionnaire PDF to this thread now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: File uploaded: "prospect_SIG_questionnaire.pdf" to #sales (visible to thread)

Sam (Solutions): Got it — I'll pair with Morgan on SCIM samples and schedule the walkthrough slots after we review the PDF.

Morgan (Security): Starting compilation now. Will post the artifact ZIP link here when ready.

Alex (Sales): Thank you!
